title: Invoice forty-two went missing
myth: Auto-number fields give a gap-free sequence, perfect for invoice numbers.

beats.say: Penny wants auto-numbered invoices. No gaps, ever. Right?
beats.speaker: penny

beats.say: A save fails and burns number forty-two. Another save grabs forty-three.
Archie says they always increase, but are never promised to be consecutive.
beats.speaker: archie

beats.say: Need a gap-free series? Fill a Text field with your own logic.
beats.speaker: archie

facts.claim: Auto-number values increase but are not guaranteed to be consecutive.
facts.evidence: Values increase but are not guaranteed to be consecutive

facts.claim: A failed save can burn an auto-number value while a parallel save takes the next one.
facts.evidence: a failed save can burn a number while a parallel save takes the next one

facts.claim: For a sequence you control, a Text field populated by your own logic is usually the safer design.
facts.evidence: a Text field populated by your own logic
